hypothesis: Multi-step user queries (e.g. 'fetch the API, format the JSON, extract the price field, hash it') embed as a single mixed vector dominated by the primary intent, leaving secondary tools (calculator, hash_text, json_format) below the top-10. Decomposing the query into atomic sub-queries via a single LLM call, then unioning per-sub-query top-k results, recovers those secondary tools without changing the tree.

papers.title: Least-to-Most Prompting Enables Complex Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.key_claim: Two-stage decompose-then-solve prompt scheme: first emit an ordered list of atomic sub-problems, then solve each. Achieves >=99% on SCAN compositional generalization vs 16% for chain-of-thought.

baseline.miss_breakdown: 19 partial-miss complex cases; 14/24 missing slots are secondary utility tools (calculator x3, hash_text x3, get_current_datetime x2, http_get x2, json_format, array_sort, percentage_calc, generate_uuid)

design.stage: pre-retrieval (between query input and traverser); zero changes to tree or index
design.prompt: Single LLM call. System: 'Break this user query into atomic sub-queries, one per tool call. The catalog covers these L1 domains: {L1_titles_and_one_line_descriptions}. Output JSON list of strings.' User: original query.
design.fusion: For each sub-query: q_emb = embed(sub_q); candidates_i = retrieve(tree, q_emb, k=rerank_k, beam=cfg.recall_beam) -> rerank_tools(...) -> top-k_per_sub. Union all into a pool keyed by tool_id; per tool keep max score across sub-queries; final top-k = sorted(pool)[:k].
files_to_touch: src/tool_index/retrieval/traverser.py - new retrieve_decomposed(tree, query, llm, embedder, tool_vectors, k) wrapper
scripts/eval_real_cases.py - add --decompose flag that swaps topk_for() for the decomposed variant
src/tool_index/config/loader.py - add decompose: bool = False field
design.prompt_compactness: Only L1 titles + one-line descriptions are injected (~500 tokens at current 9 categories). Do NOT include L2/L3 or tool names - keeps prompt scale-stable up to 10k tools.
design.cache: Reuse provider DiskCache - cache key = (query, tree_version) so retunes invalidate cleanly.

measurement.metric: complex set-recall@10 + complex full-cover cases + simple recall@10
ablation: decomposition + L1 schema in prompt (this direction)
decomposition without L1 schema (measure schema-injection delta)

risks: Sub-queries that no tool serves dilute the candidate pool with noise; mitigated because rerank stage runs per sub-query and final fusion takes max score (low-quality sub-queries naturally lose).
Latency: +1 LLM call/query (cached). Budget acceptable for batch eval; production needs cache hit-rate monitoring.
Over-decomposition of simple queries can hurt simple recall - measure both metrics every ablation.
decision_rule: Promote if complex set-recall@10 >= 0.88 with simple recall@10 >= 0.97. Cheapest decomposition direction; sets the floor for Directions 5-7.
